add_expense:
(define (add_expense amount category [note 'no_note])
  (unless (real? amount) (error 'add_expense "amount must be a number"))
  (unless (> amount 0) (error 'add_expense "amount must be greater than zero"))
  (unless (and (string? category) (> (string-length category) 0))
    (error 'add_expense "category is required"))
  (when (eq? note 'null) (error "breaks expenses-shape"))
  (unless (or (eq? note 'no_note) (string? note))
    (error 'add_expense "note must be a string"))
  (let* ([s (get-state)]
         [es (hash-ref s 'expenses '())]
         [base (hasheq 'amount amount 'category category)]
         [e (if (eq? note 'no_note) base (hash-set base 'note note))])
    (set-state! (hash-set s 'expenses (append es (list e))))
    (add1 (length es))))
by_category:
(define (by_category)
  (let ([cents (for/fold ([acc (hasheq)]) ([e (hash-ref (get-state) 'expenses '())])
                 (let ([c (hash-ref e 'category 'unknown)])
                   (hash-set acc c (+ (hash-ref acc c 0) (expense_cents e)))))])
    (for/fold ([out (hasheq)]) ([k (hash-keys cents)])
      (hash-set out k (/ (hash-ref cents k) 100)))))
top_category:
(define (top_category)
  (let ([m (by_category)])
    (if (null? (hash-keys m))
        'null
        (car (sort (hash-keys m)
                   (lambda (a b)
                     (let ([ca (money_cents (hash-ref m a 0))]
                           [cb (money_cents (hash-ref m b 0))])
                       (if (= ca cb) (string<? a b) (> ca cb)))))))))
